question: Is enough continental crust compacted in the reconstruction to build the mountains the timeline names?

literature.datum: the Main Frontal Thrust at the Sub-Himalayan front, about 27.5 N at 85 E
literature.quantity: pre-collision northward extent of Indian continental crust beyond the present northern edge of India

adria-europe.lowerPlate: Europe (Cao plates 302/305 and the distal European margin)

literature.datum: the present northern outline of Adriatic crust, the Adria-Europe partition boundary at about 47.3 N on 10 E
literature.quantity: pre-collision northward extent of Adriatic continental crust beyond its present northern outline

verdict.source: the restored Adriatic margin of data/corrections/restored-margins/; Adria's own Cao crust reaches 0.0 km north of the European margin on every meridian

literature.datum: the present Norwegian coastline, taken from the model's own plate-302 coastline polygons (5.38 E at 62 N, 12.56 E at 66 N)
literature.quantity: pre-collision westward extent of Baltican continental crust beyond the present Norwegian coastline

verdict.source: the restored Baltoscandian margin of data/corrections/restored-margins/, which reaches the published 401 km floor between 62 and 71 N. Without it the 122.2 km of Baltican crust west of the coast at 62 N is the modern stretched Atlantic shelf, not a restored Caledonian margin, and on a strict reading the model carries no restored pre-collision Baltican margin at all.

palaeoLayer.method: docs/research/palaeo-coastlines-north-sea-formation-checks.md probe: decode each shipped EHPR payload, rebuild every piece, test a present-day (lon, lat) for containment, and read the piece's catalog binding row
palaeoLayer.payloadIntegrity: all probed lm and sm payload sha256 values equal the digests their own class catalog pins
palaeoLayer.probeLegend: plate id of the piece containing the point, per class; a trailing '*' marks a PLATEID1 override binding rather than a partition binding; an empty list means no piece of that class covers the point

restoredMargins.claim: cited model-inference crust charts on the lower plate of each collision, with lifecycles that retire each strip as the model consumes it. They are crust, not land, and they join the crust group of a transect, never its datum group.
